name: Drovane Works 11 EGEO
description: Key Features Large Capacity: Sourdough fermentation vessel with a substantial 584-litre volume, ideal for commercial-scale baking operations or high-volume artisanal bread production. Flexible Pricing: Unit price is determined upon acceptance, allowing for tailored solutions based on specific business needs. Enhanced Flavor and Texture: The extended fermentation cycle and controlled microaerobic environment foster the natural development of complex flavors and chewy crumb structure, highly valued in artisan bread. Customizable Solution: Flexible pricing and configuration options provide adaptability for different operational requirements and budgets. Artisan Bread Producers: Achieve authentic, long-fermented sourdough loaves with distinctive flavor and texture, appealing to craft bread markets. Fermentation Research and Development: Utilize precise environmental controls for experimental or specialty fermentation projects requiring specific temperature and oxygen levels. Catering and Food Service: Meet high-volume demands for sourdough-based menu items while ensuring reliability and repeatability in production. Frequently Addressed User Needs Is the vessel easy to operate and maintain? Designed for straightforward operation with automated temperature and atmosphere controls, minimizing manual intervention. How does it ensure product quality? Precision engineering provides stable fermentation conditions, reducing variability and spoilage risk. Is it suitable for my production scale? With a large 584-litre capacity and support for three simultaneous batches, it is ideal for both growing and established commercial operations. This anoxic sourdough crock is engineered to meet the demands of professional fermentation, offering reliability, scalability, and superior product outcomes for businesses focused on sourdough bread production.
description_html:
Key Features

  • Large Capacity: Sourdough fermentation vessel with a substantial 584-litre volume, ideal for commercial-scale baking operations or high-volume artisanal bread production.
  • Precise Temperature Control: Maintains a consistent working temperature of 37°C, optimizing conditions for reliable sourdough fermentation and ensuring uniform dough quality.
  • Extended Batch Cycle: Supports a batch fermentation cycle of 67 days, allowing for deep flavor development and traditional sourdough characteristics.
  • Simultaneous Batch Processing: Capable of handling up to 3 batches concurrently, increasing productivity and operational efficiency.
  • Microaerobic Atmosphere Control: Equipped with advanced microaerobic controls to create a low-oxygen environment, promoting authentic anoxic sourdough fermentation and enhancing flavor profiles.
  • Flexible Pricing: Unit price is determined upon acceptance, allowing for tailored solutions based on specific business needs.

Main Benefits

  • Optimized for Large-Scale Production: The high vessel volume and ability to process multiple batches simultaneously make this sourdough crock suitable for bakeries, food manufacturers, and fermentation specialists seeking to scale up production without compromising on quality.
  • Consistent Fermentation Results: Accurate temperature and atmosphere regulation ensures every batch achieves the ideal rise, texture, and tang associated with traditional sourdough, meeting the expectations of both professional bakers and discerning customers.
  • Enhanced Flavor and Texture: The extended fermentation cycle and controlled microaerobic environment foster the natural development of complex flavors and chewy crumb structure, highly valued in artisan bread.
  • Customizable Solution: Flexible pricing and configuration options provide adaptability for different operational requirements and budgets.

Typical Use Cases and Outcomes

  • Commercial Bakeries: Streamline sourdough production, increase output, and maintain consistent product quality across large batches.
  • Artisan Bread Producers: Achieve authentic, long-fermented sourdough loaves with distinctive flavor and texture, appealing to craft bread markets.
  • Fermentation Research and Development: Utilize precise environmental controls for experimental or specialty fermentation projects requiring specific temperature and oxygen levels.
  • Catering and Food Service: Meet high-volume demands for sourdough-based menu items while ensuring reliability and repeatability in production.

Frequently Addressed User Needs

  • Is the vessel easy to operate and maintain? Designed for straightforward operation with automated temperature and atmosphere controls, minimizing manual intervention.
  • How does it ensure product quality? Precision engineering provides stable fermentation conditions, reducing variability and spoilage risk.
  • Is it suitable for my production scale? With a large 584-litre capacity and support for three simultaneous batches, it is ideal for both growing and established commercial operations.

This anoxic sourdough crock is engineered to meet the demands of professional fermentation, offering reliability, scalability, and superior product outcomes for businesses focused on sourdough bread production.
